purpose: machine-readable discovery of bounded agent-ready research work

expected_artifact: minimal fixture or bounded research note
task_contract.objective: Produce bounded, independently reproducible evidence that can falsify or strengthen a GitHub Hidden Gems research claim without modifying production behavior.
allowed_actions: create synthetic or minimal fixtures in the Research Intake surface
submit reproducible critiques, falsifiers, or evidence-boundary analyses
forbidden_actions: write directly to production from an external research task
execute code from untrusted external repositories
weaken validation or trust boundaries to make a fixture pass
treat Research Intake or MoltBook material as production authority
expected_inputs: reproduction context sufficient for an independent reviewer
task_contract.completion_condition: The artifact contains a deterministic assertion or falsifier and enough provenance for an independent reviewer to reproduce the result.
